_about: Public-domain W. J. Sparrow-Simpson, Anglo-Catholic divine and chaplain of St Mary's Hospital, Ilford, for the Word Hoard: Our Lord's Resurrection, The Resurrection and Modern Thought, The Catholic Conception of the Church, Roman Catholic Opposition to Papal Infallibility, French Catholics in the Nineteenth Century, Broad Church Theology, Modernism and the Person of Christ, and his other studies and sermons. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 121 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted. He lived past 1930, so only books printed before 1930 are taken.
